structured_output.steelman: Give active learners in an eligible market one card — on the dashboard, and as a dismissable toast at grade-posted and credential-earned — that states the exchange in a single line, makes the share link the one-tap primary action with the code demoted, and lists each referral as invited / started / credited with the amount, so learners with no channel of their own share at least once.

ambiguities.text: The one-line copy must state what the friend gets and what the learner gets, but incentive amounts are out of scope and the named dependency (referral service) only exposes per-referral state and the credited amount — not the market's offer amounts. Where does the card read 'what you get / what they get' from: referral service, a finance-owned config, or hard-coded copy per market?
ambiguities.why_it_bites_mid_build: The engineer reaches the copy line and finds no field to bind; either builds a config/backend read (S becomes M) or hard-codes amounts finance can change without telling the team.

ambiguities.text: 'Course grade posted' — the platform event is 'grade posted' (from Canvas), which fires on weekly assignment grades as well as final course grades. Which one triggers the toast, is there a frequency cap, and does a failing grade suppress it?
ambiguities.why_it_bites_mid_build: Two courses × weekly assignments means up to ~16 toasts a term if it's any grade; the engineer either filters on a field that may not exist in the event or ships a toast that fires after every assignment, including fails.

ambiguities.text: Grades post in Canvas while the learner may not be in myNXU. Does the toast fire on the next dashboard load, only in-session, once per event, and does dismissal persist across sessions/devices?
ambiguities.why_it_bites_mid_build: Events today feed the deadline rail (a list), not in-session toasts; 'show as a toast when X happens' has no delivery semantics until this is decided, and the engineer picks one.

ambiguities.text: 'Share link as the primary action' — what does the tap do: native share sheet, copy to clipboard, or a channel picker? And is the UTM already on the link the referral service issues, or appended by myNXU?
ambiguities.why_it_bites_mid_build: The Goal is measured from the link's UTM; if the link has no UTM today the measurement plan is unbuildable, and the share mechanism changes the tap count the goal is counting.

ambiguities.text: The referral-state line: how many referrals does the card list (all, last N with a count), and in what order? A learner with twenty invites makes the card a table.
ambiguities.why_it_bites_mid_build: Card height on the dashboard (variant B position is a Keep) breaks with an unbounded list; the engineer caps it arbitrarily or ships an unbounded card.

hidden_dependencies.name: Finance-owned per-market incentive amounts
hidden_dependencies.why: The platform context says markets and amounts are set by finance. The spec names the referral service for per-referral state and credited amount, but not a readable source for the offer amounts the copy line must show. If none exists, the card needs config or a backend read — this is the S-to-M risk.

hidden_dependencies.name: Analytics / UTM attribution
hidden_dependencies.why: The Goal is measured in-sprint from the link's UTM and share taps, but the platform context names no analytics pipeline and no share-tap event. Instrumenting the tap and attributing referred starts to the link is work the S estimate does not carry.

size.risk: If the referral service does not expose per-market offer amounts (what the friend gets / what the learner gets), the card needs a config or backend read plus a finance handshake, and the band moves to M.

refinement_agenda: Decide the source of the offer amounts in the copy line (referral service field, finance config, or per-market copy) and who is notified when finance changes them — this settles S vs M.
Decide the toast policy: final course grade only or any grade; once per event; fires on next dashboard load; dismissal persists; suppressed below a grade threshold or not.

Rewrite criterion 3 to an observable: 'On dashboard load, the card lists the learner's referrals (capped at N, newest first) with state invited / started / credited and the credited amount as of the last referral-service read' — and confirm the share link already carries a UTM.
structured_output.requester_message: @jose — the referral card spec is ready for Thursday triage as an S. Nothing blocks it. Two things you can bring on Thursday that would take the guesswork out of refinement: (1) where the per-market 'what your friend gets / what you get' amounts live today, if you know — the referral service, a finance sheet, or nowhere readable; if nowhere, this becomes an M because someone has to build the read. (2) Your call on the toast: after every grade posting or only the final course grade, and whether it fires after a fail. Everything else — share-sheet vs copy, how many referrals the card lists, toast delivery on next load — the designer and an engineer settle in the room. I don't have the board in front of me, so I won't claim what's In Sprint; if you want this ahead of the current sprint's queue, triage will name the S-sized item it displaces and you choose. No date from me — triage sets it.
